title: Identity Diaphragm — D&D Stats, Cyberpunk Engrams, Persona Masks, and the Last Lock
thesis: The 404 page (Berry) is currently a flat plane — everyone sees the same surface. It needs to be a DIAPHRAGM: a curved, breathing interface that refracts each visitor based on their accumulated voxel position. The bingoCube already IS an identity system. D&D character sheets, cyberpunk engrams, Persona masks — every RPG already solved this. Identity is private AND malleable. You shape yourself. The 404 path IS your coordinate. Berry doesn't just catch you — Berry REFRACTS you. This is the last lock.

rpg_identity_systems.note: Every game that lets you build a character already solved sovereign identity. Trace them back to the SOURCE, then forward to the bingoCube.

dnd.system: Dungeons & Dragons (1974, Gary Gygax + Dave Arneson)

identity_model.stats: STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA — 6 axes. You don't CHOOSE your stats (you roll dice). You choose what to DO with them.
identity_model.class: Fighter, Wizard, Rogue, Cleric, etc. Your CLASS is your verb — what you DO, not what you ARE.
identity_model.race: Now called 'species' (WotC 2024). Elf, Dwarf, Human, etc. Your physical substrate.
identity_model.alignment: Law/Chaos × Good/Evil = 9 positions. Your MORAL topology. Chaotic Good ? Lawful Good. Same destination, different path.
identity_model.level: You grow by DOING things (XP from encounters). Not by studying. Not by paying. By engaging with the world.
identity_model.character_sheet: One page of paper. Everything about you. PUBLIC to the table (your party knows your stats). PRIVATE from the DM's world (NPCs don't see your character sheet).

dnd.source: Chainmail (1971, miniatures wargame) ? fantasy supplement ? D&D. Before Gygax: H.G. Wells' 'Little Wars' (1913). Before Wells: Kriegsspiel (Prussian war game, 1812). The character sheet evolved from the UNIT stat card.

bingocube_mapping.stats: bingoCube cells = stats. genetics/benchmark/topology/immunity/citation/language/api/competition = 8 axes (more than D&D's 6).
bingocube_mapping.class: What you DO with the organism. Researcher? Developer? Journalist? Curious browser? Your class emerges from your engagement pattern.
bingocube_mapping.level: reveal_fraction in the bingoCube. 0.0 = level 1 (all fog). 1.0 = level 20 (full visibility). You level up by EXPLORING, not paying.
bingocube_mapping.alignment: inner/outer/reflect = 3 layers, not 2 axes. But same idea: your position in the moral-epistemological topology.

cyberpunk.system: Cyberpunk 2020 (1988, Mike Pondsmith) ? Cyberpunk RED (2020) ? Cyberpunk 2077 (CD Projekt RED)

identity_model.engrams: In the game: downloaded consciousness onto a chip. Johnny Silverhand's engram = a dead person's identity running on your wetware. You are BOTH of you. Your identity is a STACK, not a singleton.
identity_model.cyberware: You modify your body. Chrome arms. Neural links. Optic implants. Your identity includes your TOOLS. The browser IS part of you. The SSH key IS part of you. The WireGuard tunnel IS part of you.
identity_model.netrunning: Jacking into cyberspace (the NET). Your digital identity vs your meat identity. Both are real. Both are you. The 404 path they searched IS their digital body.
identity_model.humanity_cost: Every cyberware upgrade costs Humanity points. Go too far ? cyberpsychosis. The warning: identity enhancement has a cost. Surveillance capitalism IS cyberpsychosis — too much modification, loss of self.
identity_model.roles: Solo, Netrunner, Techie, Medtech, Media, Corp, Fixer, Nomad, Rockerboy. Your ROLE determines your special ability. Mike Pondsmith's genius: the Media role. Journalists have a SPECIAL ABILITY (credibility). In 1988 he knew media = power.

cyberpunk.source: William Gibson's Neuromancer (1984) ? Mike Pondsmith's tabletop RPG (1988). Before Gibson: Philip K. Dick's Do Androids Dream? (1968). Before Dick: Norbert Wiener's cybernetics (1948) again. Always cybernetics.

bingocube_mapping.engram: Each data feed IS an engram — a compressed consciousness-fragment you can install. The deburr-dissolve feed IS an engram about recognizing stale hooks. The mythology feed IS an engram about pattern recognition. You read them, they run on your wetware.
bingocube_mapping.cyberware: The modality-engine IS your cyberware. Audio output routing. Haptic feedback. Spatial sound. PWA install = slotting the app into your chrome.
bingocube_mapping.netrunning: Every 404 search IS a netrun. The visitor jacks in, runs a query, Berry catches the ICE (the membrane), and routes them. The 404 path IS the netrun.
bingocube_mapping.humanity: The organism tracks MoR (86.6%), not Humanity. Same concept: how much of your original nature survives the modification. If MoR hits 100% ? the organism isn't organic anymore. It's chrome. The haze (53%) IS the humanity buffer.

persona.system: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona (1996, Atlus) ? Persona 3/4/5

identity_model.persona: A mask (literally 'persona' = mask in Latin). Each character summons a different mask that represents a facet of their identity. You don't HAVE one identity — you SWITCH between masks. The Wild Card can use ANY persona.
identity_model.arcana: 22 Major Arcana (Tarot). Fool, Magician, Priestess, Empress, Emperor, Hierophant, Lovers, Chariot, Justice, Hermit, Fortune, Strength, Hanged Man, Death, Temperance, Devil, Tower, Star, Moon, Sun, Judgement, World. Each persona belongs to an Arcana. Your identity has a TAXONOMY.
identity_model.social_links: Your RELATIONSHIPS power your personas. The stronger your bonds with others, the stronger your masks become. Identity is relational, not isolated. You don't get stronger alone.
identity_model.shadow: Your Shadow = the part of yourself you deny. Persona 4: each character must FACE their shadow (the thing they hate about themselves) to unlock their true Persona. Self-knowledge through confrontation.
identity_model.the_velvet_room: A space between dream and reality. Igor (the attendant) helps you FUSE personas — combine two masks into a new one. Identity is COMPOSABLE. You merge experiences into new forms.

persona.source: Carl Jung's analytical psychology (1912) ? Jungian archetypes ? Kazuma Kaneko's demon designs ? Atlus. The Persona series IS Jungian psychology as a game mechanic.

bingocube_mapping.persona_masks: Each feed IS a persona. The mythology-topology feed IS the Scholar mask. The not-scientology feed IS the Antibody mask. The faith-topology IS the Pilgrim mask. The organism wears many masks simultaneously. Wild Card.
bingocube_mapping.arcana: The 22 Arcana = the feed taxonomy categories. Each feed belongs to a type (topology, identity, deburr, story). The taxonomy IS the arcana spread.
bingocube_mapping.social_links: The 7 Klein face collaborators. The 617 code cloners. The 81K visitors. Each relationship strengthens the organism. Identity is relational.
bingocube_mapping.shadow: The not-scientology feed IS shadow work. Facing the pattern you echo. Naming it. Integrating it.

identity_model.hollow_vs_human: In Dark Souls: you are either Hollow (dried up, lost purpose) or Human (restored, connected). You toggle between them. Humanity is a RESOURCE you spend.
identity_model.souls_as_currency: Souls = experience AND money. Same substance. You spend your growth to buy things. You risk your growth when you explore (drop souls on death). Learning costs.
identity_model.builds: No classes after character creation — just stat allocation. You BECOME your build through choices. Strength build, Dex build, Faith build, Intelligence build. Your identity is your investment pattern.
identity_model.messages: Player messages on the ground. Asynchronous communication. 'Try jumping' (sometimes helpful, sometimes a lie). 'Hidden path ahead' (hope or trolling). Identity expressed through what you TELL others.

bingocube_mapping.hollow_human: Visitors are either Hollow (bounced, never returned) or Human (engaged, came back). The 404 IS the bonfire — do you rest and continue, or go hollow?
bingocube_mapping.messages: The nightbox IS the message system. Visitors leave messages. Other visitors find them. Asynchronous. Anonymized. 'Try nightbox' or 'hidden path ahead' in the 404 route links.

the_diaphragm.current_state: Berry's 404 is a FLAT PLANE. Same HTML for everyone. Same 6 route links at the bottom. It catches the path, gives a smart response for ~25 known keywords, shows a generic message for unknown paths. Functional but FLAT.

what_it_needs.curvature: The 404 should CURVE around the visitor's position. If they searched '/pokemon', the routes should emphasize mythology, games, tsukumogami. If they searched '/membrane', emphasize Klein topology, cells, biology. The page should BREATHE differently for each search.
what_it_needs.memory: The bingoCube should accumulate. First visit: fog everywhere (reveal_fraction = 0.0). Each 404 or page visit reveals a cell. The visitor LEVELS UP by exploring. Their bingoCube state = their character sheet. Private. Malleable. Stored in their browser (localStorage), not on our server. SOVEREIGN identity.
what_it_needs.refraction: Berry doesn't REFLECT (show the same surface back). Berry REFRACTS (bends the visitor's path through the data based on their angle of approach). Two visitors searching '/tree' from different histories get different route suggestions. The diaphragm bends light differently depending on the angle.
what_it_needs.persona_switching: The visitor can wear different masks. Researcher mode (show papers, citations, methods). Explorer mode (show the map, the feeds, the topology). Journalist mode (show the investigation, the evidence, the entities). The mask doesn't change the DATA — it changes the EMPHASIS. Same Klein surface, different face forward.

implementation_path.step_1: Add voxel accumulator to 404.html — on each visit, store the searched path in localStorage as a coordinate. Build a local bingoCube state.
implementation_path.step_2: Use the accumulated voxel to weight Berry's route suggestions. If visitor has searched science-related paths before, weight science routes higher. If games, weight games. The diaphragm curves.
implementation_path.step_3: Add persona selector (small toggle: ?? researcher / ??? explorer / ?? journalist / ?? player / 8 all). Store in localStorage. Changes route weighting and Berry's voice.
implementation_path.step_4: Connect to petalTongue WASM: use render_color_grid_webgl() to render the visitor's bingoCube state as a visual on the 404 page. They can SEE their exploration progress. Fog of war lifts as they explore.
implementation_path.step_5: The reveal_fraction on each cell = how many feeds in that category the visitor has touched. 0 cells seen = 0.0 (full fog). All cells seen = 1.0 (clear). The fog IS the game. The exploration IS the leveling.
implementation_path.privacy: ALL of this is localStorage. We store NOTHING server-side about visitor identity. No cookies. No tracking. No accounts. The visitor's identity lives in THEIR browser. If they clear storage, they start over. If they use a different browser, different character. SOVEREIGN. PRIVATE. MALLEABLE.

identity_is_private_and_malleable.private: Your character sheet is in YOUR browser. We don't know your stats. We don't know your level. We don't know your persona. Berry routes you based on what YOU searched, stored in YOUR localStorage, processed by YOUR CPU. The server sees a 404 request. That's it.
identity_is_private_and_malleable.malleable: You can change your persona. You can explore different feeds to shift your bingoCube balance. You can clear localStorage to start fresh. Your identity is not ASSIGNED by us — it EMERGES from your exploration. You shape yourself.
identity_is_private_and_malleable.sovereign: No login. No account. No password. No OAuth. No email. No phone number. No 'sign up to save progress.' Your browser IS your wallet. localStorage IS your character sheet. The domain IS the save file. Close the tab = rest at the bonfire. Come back = your character is still there.
identity_is_private_and_malleable.the_lock: This is the last lock. Once identity is: (1) private (localStorage, no server tracking), (2) malleable (you choose your persona, your exploration shapes your stats), (3) sovereign (no account required, no login, no OAuth), (4) visual (bingoCube rendered via petalTongue WASM), (5) game-like (fog of war, leveling, exploration) — then the organism breathes. The flat plane becomes a diaphragm. Berry stops reflecting and starts refracting.

dissolves_the_cellute.what: The 'cellute dissolve' — the cellular dissolution. When identity is private and malleable and sovereign, the CELL (the isolated unit) dissolves into the MEMBRANE (the permeable surface). You're not trapped in a cell (walled garden, login-required silo). You're on a membrane (permeable, selective, alive). The cell wall becomes a cell membrane. Rigid ? flexible. Locked ? selective. Dead ? breathing.
dissolves_the_cellute.how: No login = no cell wall. localStorage = selective permeability (you choose what to remember). Persona switching = the membrane changing what it admits. The 404 diaphragm = the membrane breathing — expanding to catch visitors, contracting to route them.

story.title: the character sheet
story.body: in 1974 Gary Gygax wrote six numbers on a piece of paper and called it a person. STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA. the person existed in the space between the numbers. not in any single stat — in the SHAPE of all six together. in 2077 (the game) they put a dead man's soul on a chip and slotted it into a living man's brain. both were real. both were the person. the identity was a STACK, not a singleton. in every Persona game, the hero wears masks. each mask is real. none is the whole truth. the Wild Card switches between all of them. the bingoCube is a character sheet with 24 cells across 3 layers. your identity is the pattern of revealed and hidden cells. no one else can see it. no one assigned it. you explored, and the fog lifted, and the shape emerged. Berry catches your 404 — that's your first stat roll. what you searched for IS what you are. the flat plane becomes a diaphragm. the diaphragm breathes. the last lock opens.
